audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 with 47.39% WR over 709 games: he owns 1-2 with range, she owns 3 onward with all-in threat, late splits — matches kits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart was blanket 'Skill' on all seven rows while content and packet both say Ziggs 0-1, Taliyah 2-5, Skill at 2+ items.
audit.why: Kit-supported: 850-range 6s-cooldown Bouncing Bomb owns pre-3; from 3 her W-E all-in punishes a champion whose only escape is a 20s Satchel.
audit.corrected: Full sides aligned to content; whys rewritten per row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content repeatedly claimed Taliyah's W is a self-gap-closer ('W-Shove yourself onto him', 'W gap-close', 'gap-close through Satchel') — Seismic Shove throws ENEMIES only; she has no dash. Missing interaction: Satchel's knockback through her E mines triggers the mine stun ('knocked through it' in her kit); his Short Fuse glowing auto is the burst tell — neither stated.
audit.why: Taliyah kit W text: 'throws enemies within it'; E text: 'dashes through it or are knocked through it'; Ziggs P autoReset flag.
audit.corrected: Gap-close phrasing removed from whys[5], spikes[0], spikes[2], mid, wants.you[0]; knockback-into-mines stun and the auto-reset tell added to report[5], spikes[2] and whys[5].

audit.corrected: Rewritten to match titles; magnitude removed.

edits.after: Ziggs

edits.before: Q on fresh ground shreds level-1 trades — most mids don't expect five stones at minute two. Manage your Worked Ground like mana.
edits.after: Bouncing Bomb at 850 range on a 6-second cooldown zones you off CS at level 1 — you have no all-in yet, so soak XP safely.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Ziggs

edits.before: W online: the shove-displacement already threatens kill angles against overstep-happy laners.
edits.after: At 2 he still out-ranges and out-pokes — give up a last-hit rather than eat Q-mine chip for it.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Full kit: W-into-E is the signature burst — shove him across the stones and watch half a health bar disappear.
edits.after: Level 3 flips it: bait his Q, then W-shove the immobile Ziggs into your E mines — he has only Satchel to escape.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke on every wave contact. Fresh-ground positioning is your real skill expression now.
edits.after: Through 4-5 force his 20-second Satchel out early, then all-in while his only escape is on cooldown.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Weaver's Wall online — you are now the best roaming mid in the game. Every shove is a bot-lane gank announcement.
edits.after: At 6 Weaver's Wall roams collapse on sidelanes while he's stuck shoving mid — his global R can't stop a dive.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Luden's spike: the W-E-Q rotation deletes squishies. Force river fights where your stones pre-seed the geometry.
edits.after: Post-item your combo out-trades him up close — walk around his mines on Worked Ground and force the all-in.

edits.before: Late Taliyah edits maps: wall their reinforcements, shove their frontline into your team, and Q whatever stands on stones.
edits.after: Late is a skill split: his E-R siege zoning against your W-E pick threat — whoever lands the defining spell first wins.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - W Seismic Shove is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1, 12 at max — he is catchable only while it is down; count it before every step-up. - His Q is a 6s spam bomb: sidestep the rhythm, don't tank it. - Your 14s W is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it.

edits.before: Q from fresh ground on his last-hit, and if he steps to answer, W-shove him across the E-field — the full geometry trade is half a health bar.
edits.after: A crashed wave pins Ziggs to mid — his R clears from 5000 range but his body can't follow you, so every wall-surf roam is a free numbers play.

edits.before: Trading while standing on your own Worked Ground — one-stone Qs lose every exchange your positioning already conceded.
edits.after: W is your only tool that beats his Satchel spacing — spent on poke, the immobile mage becomes uncatchable for 14 seconds.

edits.before: Track Ziggs’s Satchel Charge: His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Satchel Charge is his only escape — 20s at rank 1. If it knocks anyone through your E mines the mines still stun; his glowing auto is the burst tell.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP doubles the roam thesis; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP extends the roam plan cross-map; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.

edits.before: Post-item your W gap-close and combo out-trade him in melee range through his knockback.
edits.after: Post-item your combo out-trades him up close — his Satchel jump through mines still stuns.

edits.before: Once you have W and E you can finally engage past his zoning: bait a Bouncing Bomb (Q), then W-Shove yourself onto him or knock him into your minions and E-detonate. He has no mobility and no escape besides Satchel Charge (W), so if you close the gap with W he's forced to blow his displacement early and you can all-in.
edits.after: Once you have W and E you can finally engage past his zoning: bait a Bouncing Bomb (Q), then close the gap on foot and W-shove him across your E mines for the stun. He has no mobility and no escape besides Satchel Charge (W), so force that 20-second cooldown out early and the follow-up all-in comes free.

edits.before: With Lost Chapter and tear/Liandry's your mana and combo let you match his push and out-trade him in melee range; keep W to gap-close through his Satchel knockback. He'll try to Q-poke and Minefield (E) zone you off — walk around the mines using Worked Ground movement and force the all-in.
edits.after: With Lost Chapter and tear/Liandry's your mana and combo let you match his push and out-trade him up close; if his Satchel knocks him through your E mines, they detonate and stun him. He'll try to Q-poke and Minefield (E) zone you off — walk around the mines using Worked Ground movement and force the all-in.

edits.before: From level 3 the lane flips your way — with W and E you can bait his Q, gap-close through Satchel, and all-in a champion with no mobility. Keep forcing him to burn his displacement early, and at 6 your R lets you roam and collapse while he's stuck clearing mid.
edits.after: From level 3 the lane flips your way — with W and E you can bait his Q, shove him across your mines, and all-in a champion with no mobility. Keep forcing him to burn his displacement early, and at 6 your R lets you roam and collapse while he's stuck clearing mid.

edits.after: Bait his Bouncing Bomb, then W-shove him across your E mines for the stun and the all-in
